title: Quantifying the Benefit of Artificial Intelligence for Scientific Research

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating the share of women scientists within different scientific disciplines (using Survey of Doctorate Recipients data) to the discipline's AI impact score, and using name-based gender inference algorithms on publication data to compare citation premiums and field leadership between female and male researchers engaging in AI.

Correlating the proportion of underrepresented minority (URM) scientists, such as Black researchers, within a discipline to the discipline's AI impact score, and utilizing name-based race inference to assess differences in citation premiums and leadership for URM versus non-URM researchers after they engage in AI research.
